description.narrative: The Tonga Health Programme Coordinator will coordinate all of MFAT's health investments in Tonga (bilateral and multi-country) to ensure: complementarity across activities, effective implementation, strong local ownership and coordination with development partners. The Tonga Health Programme Coordinator is a 12 month pilot project which will be reviewed at 9 months to determine ongoing need and focus of the role.
